title: Learning to Build: Autonomous Robotic Assembly of Stable Structures Without Predefined Plans
abstract: arXiv:2602.23934v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper presents a novel autonomous robotic assembly framework for constructing stable structures without relying on predefined architectural blueprints. Instead of following fixed plans, construction tasks are defined through targets and obstacles, allowing the system to adapt more flexibly to environmental uncertainty and variations during the building process. A reinforcement learning (RL) policy, trained using deep Q-learning with successor features, serves as the decision-making component. As a proof of concept, we evaluate the approach on a benchmark of 15 2D robotic assembly tasks of discrete block construction. Experiments using a real-world closed-loop robotic setup demonstrate the feasibility of the method and its ability to handle construction noise. The results suggest that our framework offers a promising direction for more adaptable and robust robotic construction in real-world environments.

translated_title: 学习建造：无需预定义计划的稳定结构自主机器人装配
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种新颖的自主机器人装配框架，能够在不依赖预定义建筑蓝图的情况下构建稳定结构。与遵循固定计划不同，建筑任务通过目标和障碍物来定义，使系统能够更灵活地适应建造过程中的环境不确定性和变化。系统采用基于深度Q学习与后继特征训练的强化学习（RL）策略作为决策组件。作为概念验证，我们在包含15个离散积木搭建的2D机器人装配任务的基准上对该方法进行了评估。基于真实世界闭环机器人装置的实验证明了该方法的可行性及其处理建造噪声的能力。结果表明，该框架为实现现实环境中更具适应性和鲁棒性的机器人建造提供了有前景的方向。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需预定义建筑蓝图、利用强化学习策略（深度Q学习与后继特征）自主构建稳定结构的机器人装配框架，能够灵活适应环境不确定性并有效处理建造噪声。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an autonomous robotic assembly framework that builds stable structures without predefined blueprints by using a reinforcement learning policy trained with deep Q-learning and successor features, enabling flexible adaptation to environmental uncertainty and robustness to construction noise.
